messages:
mia: Quick sync: ops noticed console shows internal routing codes. We need a tiny, stable public contract for errors.
kevin: Agreed. Keep it to an enum + 2 short hints. Easier for SDKs and dashboards.
sienna: Propose enums: TRANSIENT, QUOTA, DEGRADED, ACTION_REQUIRED. Map to i18n keys for display.
mia: API fields: error_category (enum), ui_text (i18n key), retry_hint (retryable/no-retry), quota_reset_s (optional).
kevin: Example payload to include in RFC: {"error_category":"QUOTA","ui_text":"error.quota.short","retry_hint":"no-retry","quota_reset_s":"1200"} 
ops-bot: notice: feature-flag client_error_enum_v1 scheduled for canary 2025-03-01T02:00Z.
sienna: Rollout: emit legacy_code and new error_category for 21 days, then flip console to i18n keys. Dashboards should use error_category once stable.
mia: SDK guidance: if retry_hint=="retryable" retry with backoff; if "no-retry" surface CTA. Add headers X-Error-Category and X-Fallback-Source for observability.
